invariants.rationale: The method returns a HoodieData<WriteStatus> constructed from a list, which should not be null.
The source data must be non-null to be collected and processed.
A valid HoodieEngineContext is required to call downstream methods.
The table reference is passed to child processing and must not be null.
The returned HoodieData is constructed via HoodieListData.eager, so must be an instance of HoodieListData.
